approval_contract.title: Task progress update
approval_contract.verifier: contextual trusted progress view bound to scope/task/current task prose digest/purpose; task intake rejects progress refs

cases.oracle: Missing/stale/changed body, code literal, skill policy, purpose or scoped contextual approval rejects before durable publication or HTTP.
Submit durably records exact approved body and owned canonical issue before any comment effect; same operation returns one record, changed payload/foreign scope conflicts.
Actual loopback GraphQL commentCreate and comment readback confirm exact canonical owned issue/account/project and provider Markdown; no task/status/worker/AI receipt is fabricated.
Wrong account/project/issue/assignment and changed task prose reject before publication; raw comment text alone cannot bypass trusted approval.
Malformed/false/partial-error/timeout/readback mismatch preserves failed or uncertain result; no blind duplicate comment retry.
Restart after returned UUID or exact readback recovers by canonical comment ID; unknown lost create remains uncertain.
Comment candidate UUID disabled without verified schema; if supported, persist candidate before effect and settle only exact matching readback. Missing/wrong candidate never proves absence.
Concurrent publishers claim one intent; lease expiry becomes uncertain; no second comment is posted.
Contextual progress receipt cannot be replayed as task intake, for another task/session, or after the bound task prose changes.
Provider comment acknowledgement remains separate from progress verification, worker completion, lead AI acknowledgement and user report.
Comment request uses structured variables, preserves literals and redacts credential/provider private text in errors and diagnostics.
The live plan includes one approved run-owned progress comment, exact readback and ledger-owned cleanup; local fixtures do not claim live proof.
